name: harvestmath-plantcare
description: HarvestMath Plant Care — one HTML file, no account, no subscription, works offline.

scripts.build: vite build --outDir build-tmp && node scripts/emit.mjs && node scripts/demo-file.mjs && node scripts/emit-pwa.mjs && npm run build:demo
scripts.port: node scripts/port-data.mjs && node scripts/build-toxicity.mjs && node scripts/build-species.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:data && npm run verify:species && npm run verify:schedule && npm run verify:file && npm run verify:camera
scripts.build:demo: vite build --mode demo --outDir build-tmp-demo && node scripts/emit.mjs build-tmp-demo demo/index.html
